Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Faculty of Arts of the University of Pristina, the only public institution in the field, runs three departments, visual arts, musical arts and dramatic arts, the last opened in 1989-90 with an acting stream and now counting eight undergraduate profiles. No puppetry profile was identified. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1: the eight profiles were not enumerated at source and one of them could fall within the field. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
